title: Animate Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🎞️animate plugin from its old 7-crate constitutional layout into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree (artifacts, apps, modes, windows, panels, commands, etc.), following the W1 pilot's recipe written up in 📋️TEMPLATE.md under the master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE. This is wave W2 of the repo-wide crate consolidation. Exclusive ownership: everything under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/**. Plugin has an app 🎬️present and a sizeable plugin-level 🫀️core module (~7000 lines) whose placement (shared kernel vs folded into the one artifact engine) depends on verifying its actual dependents. Must preserve package metadata verbatim, prove wire-format byte-identical via hex dump technique, and pass cargo check (native+wasm32-wasip2)/clippy -D warnings/cargo test before deleting old crates.
summary: Migrated the 🎞️animate plugin's 10 old constitutional-layout crates into ONE crate (semio-s-plugin-animate) at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy tree, following 📋️TEMPLATE.md exactly. The plugin-level 🫀️core (Manim-class animation core, ~7000 lines) and 🎥️video (headless video engine, ~1200 lines) crates were folded into the present artifact's ⚙️engine as sibling 🦀️animate_core.rs/🦀️animate_video.rs topic files (verified via dependency grep: neither has a dependent outside this one app/artifact, so the simpler placement rule applies, not a plugin-level 🫀️core). PresentCommand (19 variants) was decomposed via app_commands! into 6 command-group files. All verification passed: cargo check native + wasm32-wasip2, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings (zero warnings in my crate), cargo test (208/208 pass, exceeding the 189-test baseline floor), and a byte-for-byte wire-format diff proof (old present_protocol crate's PresentCommand vs new app_commands!-generated PresentCommand, all 19 variants, diff exit 0 / fully identical). Found and fixed a pre-existing bug: the old ui.rs crate had 13 "mismatched closing delimiter" syntax errors already committed to HEAD (not a concurrent edit — confirmed via clean git status), meaning it and the manifest crate never actually compiled; fixed naturally during transcription into per-command handler functions. Repointed the shared 🧪️fixture-sweep cross-dependent (🧰️framework/.../🗣️dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep) from the deleted semio-s-app-animate-present facade to the new merged crate, matching the exact precedent already set by sibling W2 agents (flow/writer/vcs_app) in that same shared file. Old crate directories (🛂️manifest/, 🎛️apps/🎬️present/⚡️implementations/, 🎛️apps/🎬️present/🔨️modules/, 🔨️modules/🫀️core/, 🔨️modules/🎥️video/) deleted only after all checks passed on the isolated new crate. Did NOT touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, the registry script, or launch.json — registrar handoff details reported to the orchestrator. No 🎪️demonstrator dependency on animate found. TS-only renderer module (🎛️apps/🎬️present/📺️renderer/⚛️react) left untouched (out of scope, Rust-only migration).
